name: Augmented GD
description: Turn every level into a roguelite run. Die, draft an augment, get stronger, and finally beat it.

keybind-slowmo.name: Toggle Slow-Mo
keybind-slowmo.description: Toggles the Slow-Mo augment on/off during a run.

keybind-checkpoint.name: Place Checkpoint
keybind-checkpoint.description: Places a checkpoint (Checkpoint augment) during a run.

keybind-brake.name: Brake (hold)
keybind-brake.description: Hold to slow the game down (Brake augment) during a run.

debug-mode.name: Debug mode
debug-mode.description: Testing aid. Keys 1-9 grant one level of the matching augment (table order: shield, slow-mo, startpos, foresight, unmirror, hazard-hitbox, wave-hitbox, nerve, draft-count; Shift+1 = cat, Shift+2 = brake, Shift+3 = missile, Shift+4 = berserker), and key 0 fills the draft gauge (the draft still happens on death). The draft cost is the normal one (30, +5 per draft, stopping at 100).
